args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24%, highlighting the scale of the returns challenge in retail logistics.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (~20%).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin.

Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns and https://insights.ironbark.example/returns/companion
